description:
Create a transparent sprite atlas of 24 separate fantasy RPG status icons, EXACTLY 3 columns by 8 rows. Canvas384x512: each cell128x64; centers x64,192,320 and y32,96,160,224,288,352,416,480. One compact icon inside each cell, maximum48x48, empty transparent margins. No text, labels, letters, grid, frame, background, pedestal, badges or UI circles. Match reference game sprite: hand-drawn pixel-art miniature, crisp clustered pixels, dark local contour, clear 3-tone sculpted light/shadow, cool steel, worn leather, restrained colors, modest highlights. Recognizable solid objects and materials, not flat vector symbols, not glossy mobile icons. Top-left light, subtle 3/4 volume. Every row depicts ONE effect with 3 different visual motifs, left A/middle B/right C. Keep all rows equally spaced. Rows top to bottom:
1 BLEEDING red: A plump dark-red blood drop with tiny highlight; B fresh slash wound with red drop; C bloodstained linen bandage.
2 BURNING orange: A compact orange flame with hot core; B smoldering charcoal with flame; C burning scrap of leather.
3 POISON dark green: A dark-green sickly skull; B small green poison vial with skull stopper; C venom fang and green drop.
4 ACID lime: A lime drop eating holes in steel plate; B corroded sword with lime acid drop; C acid eating through leather boot. NO skull.
5 STUN white: A bowed human head with two white stars; B dented helmet with white impact stars; C head with small white spinning star ring.
6 ENTANGLED brown: A boots tightly bound in brown rope; B gnarled roots around ankle; C thick knotted snare around two boots.
7 FROZEN ice blue: A sharp six-armed ice crystal; B boot trapped inside ice; C compact faceted icicle cluster.
8 WET blue: A blue water drop; B three blue droplets; C soaked leather cloth dripping water.
